verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a documented legacy-to-current endpoint mapping (e.g., /run_new_enrichment → /enrich, /run_status → /runs/{id}). This shows the API has evolved and the docs offer some migration guidance. Nothing in the pack describes an explicit API versioning scheme or a formal deprecation policy, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: an explicit versioning scheme (version in path or header), a documented deprecation policy with timelines or sunset notices, a changelog, and independent corroboration.
